system.special: <p><strong><p><strong>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Paralysis: </strong> </strong> &lt;/strong&gt; The touch of a thoul paralyses as a ghoul does.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Regeneration: If damaged, it regains 1 hit point per round while alive.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/p&gt;</p></p>
system.description: A thoul is a magical combination of a ghoul, a hobgoblin and a troll, and is not Undead. Except up close it looks exactly like a hobgoblin, so thouls often serve as guards to hobgoblin kings and Chaotic rulers.
